# Islamic Dream Reflection

Islamic Dream Reflection is an educational dream reflection platform inspired by Islamic traditions and classical scholarship.

The website provides:
- Dream reflection tools
- Islamic tradition inspired symbol explanations
- Classical source context

The website does not:
- Issue fatwas
- Predict future events
- Claim religious authority

- Dream Reflection Tool: https://islamicdreamreflection.com/interpreter

- Dead Person Dream Meaning in Islam: https://islamicdreamreflection.com/dreams/dead-person-dream-islam

- Water Dream Meaning in Islam: https://islamicdreamreflection.com/dreams/water-dream-islam
